title: Carve 0.2 ordered list styles
description: The kind of an ordered list: its numbering style, which the first marker alone fixes, and its delimiter. `styles` is sorted by name, `delimiters` by the code point of `char`.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

style.description: The value of `marker.style` in the tree.

first_marker.description: The first markers that give the style. The cited clauses define each.

html_type.description: The `type` attribute of the list in HTML. `null`: none is written.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

sibling.description: Which later one-letter marker is a sibling in a list of the style.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

data_delim.description: The value of `data-delim` in HTML. `null`: the attribute is not written.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

attribute.description: The key on the attribute line of the list that sets the number of the first item.

omitted_when.description: The start value that is not recorded in the tree and not written in HTML.
